verification_limit: Two complete primary PDF sources add six new initial textile-related sample-state pairs and ten ordinary TG records; evidence upgrades and legacy completions are zero. Four AASMP cotton fabric states are control and initial20/25/30percent baths, with own prose LOI18.5/39/40/45. Explicit gas-named prose reports measured R7008.4/19.7/31.4/39.2 in N2 and1.4/15.7/20.3/25.4 in air; ordinary TG is40-700C at20Kmin, equivalent to20Cmin. Fig7 caption and prose invert panel gas references; this source anomaly is preserved in every row. Only unambiguous gas-named numerical prose is used; no panel or curve is estimated. Generic treatedT5_228/control279 is concentration-unbound and overlaps an air water-loss discussion, so all canonical threshold and peak fields for cotton remain blank. Abstract34.2percent at800C is gas-unbound and conflicts with the700C program; it is auxiliary and never substituted for measured R700. AASMP bath percentages have an unqualified basis, not retained coating fractions. Cotton128.56gm2 is scoured/bleached; treatment is70C1h,about120percent wet pickup,cure170C6min,tap-water rinse,dry60C. Initial finish rinsing is distinct from durability laundering. Own LOI uses ASTM D2863-2000 and5x14cm supported fabric; unknown repeats and conditioning remain blank. Five cotton facts remain held:5/10percent baths ownLOI29.5/25.8 in literal source order, and50LC20/25/30percent ownLOI26/27.5/31, all without own matching numerical TG. Two ramie-related pairs are whole short-ramie-fiber/PP hot-pressed composite sheets PP/RF and PP/FR-RF, not standalone fibers or woven fabrics. Own prose LOI18/20 joins Table2 T5_344/281,Tmax1_367/291,Tmax2_461/472; measured R500/R600/R700 is0/0/0 and14.0/13.1/12.6. Ordinary TG is N2 at10Kmin40-700C,50mLmin,NETZSCH TG209F1. LOI is ASTM D2863-97 on130x6.5x3.2mm sheets. Table1 PP100phr,PP-g-MAH5phr,RF or FR-RF40phr is not40wtpercent; approximately15percent FR shell refers to functionalized fiber total, not composite. Separate standalone RF/FR/FR-RF TG-only facts lack own LOI and remain held; neatPP LOI18/TG is an explicitly excluded non-textile comparator. Cone residues1.5/14.2 are not ordinary TG residues0/12.6. All24 primary PDF pages,six tables,eighteen figure captions and two schemes were read as native text. Two library originals and two native caches remain hash-bound. All110 separate source guards and five source regression tests pass; this is a separate pass by the same primary agent, not an independent human review.
